query FindAllRecordPageLayouts {
  getPageLayouts(pageLayoutType: RECORD_PAGE) {
    ...PageLayoutFragment
    __typename
  }
}

fragment PageLayoutWidgetFragment on PageLayoutWidget {
  id
  applicationId
  universalIdentifier
  isSystemSideEffect
  title
  type
  objectMetadataId
  createdAt
  updatedAt
  isActive
  deletedAt
  conditionalDisplay
  conditionalAvailabilityExpression
  gridPosition {
    column
    columnSpan
    row
    rowSpan
    __typename
  }
  position {
    ... on PageLayoutWidgetGridPosition {
      layoutMode
      row
      column
      rowSpan
      columnSpan
      __typename
    }
    ... on PageLayoutWidgetVerticalListPosition {
      layoutMode
      index
      heightBehavior
      __typename
    }
    ... on PageLayoutWidgetCanvasPosition {
      layoutMode
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  configuration {
    ... on BarChartConfiguration {
      configurationType
      aggregateFieldMetadataId
      aggregateOperation
      primaryAxisGroupByFieldMetadataId
      primaryAxisGroupBySubFieldName
      primaryAxisDateGranularity
      primaryAxisOrderBy
      primaryAxisManualSortOrder
      secondaryAxisGroupByFieldMetadataId
      secondaryAxisGroupBySubFieldName
      secondaryAxisGroupByDateGranularity
      secondaryAxisOrderBy
      secondaryAxisManualSortOrder
      omitNullValues
      axisNameDisplay
      displayDataLabel
      displayLegend
      numberFormat
      rangeMin
      rangeMax
      color
      description
      filter
      groupMode
      layout
      isCumulative
      splitMultiValueFields
      timezone
      firstDayOfTheWeek
      __typename
    }
    ... on LineChartConfiguration {
      configurationType
      aggregateFieldMetadataId
      aggregateOperation
      primaryAxisGroupByFieldMetadataId
      primaryAxisGroupBySubFieldName
      primaryAxisDateGranularity
      primaryAxisOrderBy
      primaryAxisManualSortOrder
      secondaryAxisGroupByFieldMetadataId
      secondaryAxisGroupBySubFieldName
      secondaryAxisGroupByDateGranularity
      secondaryAxisOrderBy
      secondaryAxisManualSortOrder
      omitNullValues
      axisNameDisplay
      displayDataLabel
      displayLegend
      numberFormat
      rangeMin
      rangeMax
      color
      description
      filter
      isStacked
      isCumulative
      splitMultiValueFields
      timezone
      firstDayOfTheWeek
      __typename
    }
    ... on PieChartConfiguration {
      configurationType
      groupByFieldMetadataId
      aggregateFieldMetadataId
      aggregateOperation
      groupBySubFieldName
      dateGranularity
      orderBy
      manualSortOrder
      displayDataLabel
      showCenterMetric
      displayLegend
      numberFormat
      hideEmptyCategory
      splitMultiValueFields
      color
      description
      filter
      timezone
      firstDayOfTheWeek
      __typename
    }
    ... on AggregateChartConfiguration {
      configurationType
      aggregateFieldMetadataId
      aggregateOperation
      label
      displayDataLabel
      numberFormat
      description
      filter
      prefix
      suffix
      timezone
      firstDayOfTheWeek
      ratioAggregateConfig {
        fieldMetadataId
        optionValue
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    ... on IframeConfiguration {
      configurationType
      url
      __typename
    }
    ... on StandaloneRichTextConfiguration {
      configurationType
      body {
        blocknote
        markdown
        tiptap
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    ... on CalendarConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on EmailsConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on EmailThreadConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on CallRecordingSummaryConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on CallRecordingTranscriptConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on ChatThreadsConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on ChatConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on MessageCampaignBodyConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on MessageCampaignDetailsConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on FieldConfiguration {
      configurationType
      fieldDisplayMode
      fieldMetadataId
      viewId
      nestedRelationFieldMetadataId
      isUIEditable
      __typename
    }
    ... on FieldRichTextConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on FieldsConfiguration {
      configurationType
      viewId
      newFieldDefaultVisibility
      shouldAllowUserToSeeHiddenFields
      __typename
    }
    ... on FormFieldConfiguration {
      configurationType
      fieldMetadataId
      __typename
    }
    ... on FilesConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on NotesConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on TasksConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on TimelineConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on ViewConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on RecordTableConfiguration {
      configurationType
      viewId
      recordLimit
      isUIEditable
      __typename
    }
    ... on WorkflowConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on WorkflowRunConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on WorkflowVersionConfiguration {
      configurationType
      __typename
    }
    ... on FrontComponentConfiguration {
      configurationType
      frontComponentId
      headerCommandMenuItemUniversalIdentifiers
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  pageLayoutTabId
  __typename
}

fragment PageLayoutTabFragment on PageLayoutTab {
  id
  applicationId
  universalIdentifier
  isSystemSideEffect
  title
  icon
  position
  layoutMode
  widgets {
    ...PageLayoutWidgetFragment
    __typename
  }
  pageLayoutId
  isActive
  createdAt
  updatedAt
  __typename
}

fragment PageLayoutFragment on PageLayout {
  id
  applicationId
  name
  objectMetadataId
  type
  universalIdentifier
  isSystemSideEffect
  isFirstTabPinned
  defaultTabToFocusOnMobileAndSidePanelId
  createdAt
  updatedAt
  tabs {
    ...PageLayoutTabFragment
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}
